sv.title: Därför pratar alla borgare om danska modellen
sv.summary: De borgerliga partierna förlorade valet men hoppas ändå knipa makten genom att locka till sig Centerpartiet. Men Sverigedemokraterna då, undrar Centerpartiet, hur ska vi slippa beroende av dem? Genom den danska modellen! svarar Ulf Kristerssons lag.

en.title: Why all the centre-right are talking about the Danish model
en.summary: The centre-right parties lost the election but hope to gain power by attracting the Centre Party. But what about the Sweden Democrats, the Centre Party asks, how do we avoid depending on them? Through the Danish model! replies Ulf Kristersson's law.
